settings.hero_desc: A detailed miniature of a solar water heater - tank and collector panel - in your branding, presented in a clear case. A smart product showcase and corporate gift for manufacturers and distributors.
settings.s1_body: A miniature of your own product makes a memorable gift and a clear sales aid. We reproduce your solar water heater - tank, collector panel and fittings - in your branding, cased for protection and optionally fitted with a spec plaque. Produced as a single showcase piece or in matched batches for gifting and exhibitions.
settings.case_body: Produced as branded miniatures for Zenith Solar Water Heater, these cased solar water heaters became a popular gift which they used to give their distributors. About 200 units were made and distributed. Recipients kept them on their desks and used them to explain the product in meetings.
settings.case_quote: Distributors love receiving a mini of our heater. Easier for our distributors to explain our products.
settings.prov_p: A detailed miniature of your product is a gift people keep and a sales aid that travels. It carries your brand far longer than a brochure.
